*A raging storm appears, striking your foes with lightning and throwing them around with wind.*

| **Area, Magic, [Ranged](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/ranged)**  |               **Main action** |
|--------------------------|------------------------------:|
| **📏 3 [cube](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/cube) within 10**  | **🎯 Each enemy in the area** |

**[Power Roll](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/power-roll) + [Intuition](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/intuition):**

- **≤11:** 2 lightning damage; vertical [slide](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) 1
- **12-16:** 5 lightning damage; vertical [slide](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) 2
- **17+:** 7 lightning damage; vertical [slide](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) 3
